subject: MSA + Order Form: allocation of IP risk, notice mechanics and insurance offset
messages:
From: David Li <david.li@whitecaplegal.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aperture Labs MSA / Order Form - IP indemnity allocation

Markus / Kimberly —

Thanks for the redline set. Aperture has reviewed the MSA + Order Form and we have two priority asks on the indemnity section before Procurement moves to signature:

1) Allocation of third-party IP claims when output is generated by fine-tuned models or chain-of-calls (we want a clear carve-in / carve-out approach).
2) Notice and evidence collection window — customer needs a defined SLA and contact for evidence preservation (48 hours recommended).

We attached a short summary and the in-house counsel's proposed clause (see attached). Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week if helpful.

Regards,
David Li
Senior Counsel | WhiteCap Legal (on behalf of Aperture Labs)
attachments: Aperture_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx), proof_of-origin_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: David Li <david.li@whitecaplegal.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Labs MSA / Order Form - IP indemnity allocation

David / Eleanor —

Thanks for the summary and the draft wording. Quick note from my side: we understand the need for clarity on fine-tune/output-driven claims. Two operational points we should align on before any contractual language is finalized:

- Evidence custody: we need to confirm what Aperture will be able to provide (input IDs, prompts, and a timestamped snapshot) vs. what Redwood is expected to retain. Our default retention window is 30 days for prompt/response payloads unless explicitly extended in the Order Form.
- Insurance offset: can Aperture share preferred insurer contact/info? Redwood typically allows an insurance offset mechanism (carrier-to-carrier coordination) rather than a contractual cap reduction; we find that expedites remediation.

Kimberly — looping you in to propose concrete redline options (defend vs. reimburse, notice windows, and evidence obligations). Ben / Logan — any commercial/ops constraints we should surface to the Aperture team?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: David Li <david.li@whitecaplegal.com>, Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@aperturelabs.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 May 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Labs MSA / Order Form - IP indemnity allocation

Markus / David / team —

Appreciate the clear asks. I reviewed Aperture's proposed clause and inserted three alternative tracks into the attached redline (short descriptions below):

Track A — Narrow customer-friendly carve-in for claims based on customer-provided data only: Redwood retains standard carveouts for model training data and open-source third-party components.

Track B — Hybrid defend/reimburse with a 30-day notice and an ops cooperation requirement (Redwood leads defense where we have control; customer may control defense for derivatives tied only to customer prompts).

Track C — Full defend option with an insurance-offset clause and escrowed evidence handover (we'd require a Letter of Cooperation from the customer insurer at signature).

Specific asks from legal/ops perspective:
- Reduce Redwood's evidence retention expectation to "on request" plus snapshots that the customer provides within 7 calendar days. We cannot keep full payloads beyond 30 days without an extended retention fee.
- For third-party claims arising from model outputs, require that the customer provision initial claim notices to Redwood within 48 hours of customer receipt of the third-party notice; Redwood will then be given 14 calendar days to accept/decline defense control.
- Insurer contact: customer should provide insurer name and claims liaison; we can add the carrier-to-carrier coordination language.

Attachments: Aperture_MSA_redline_v3.docx (redline, contains Tracks A/B/C)

Please review Track B as the preferred middle ground — it balances operational feasibility and customer assurance. I recommend a short call Tuesday 5/23 to walk through the defend vs reimburse mechanics and the evidence timeline.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
attachments: Aperture_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@aperturelabs.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai, David Li <david.li@whitecaplegal.com>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Labs MSA / Order Form - IP indemnity allocation

Eleanor —

Thanks for raising the questions. From a commercial viewpoint Aperture's asks are reasonable provided we can:
- Limit extended retention requests to negotiated add-ons (we can quote a retention fee if they want longer preservation).
- Agree on a mutual SLA for initial claim acknowledgement (we can do 48 hours as long as defense-control windows are firm).

Logan: are there any technical constraints on providing timestamped prompt/response snapshots for 30 days for a single enterprise customer? If it requires additional engineering (cost or infra changes), call it out so I can factor into the commercial proposal.

Eleanor — can you confirm whether Procurement wants Redwood to accept defense control in Track B (Redwood-led defense) or prefers Track C (customer-led with insurer coordination)? Once we have that preference, we can finalize commercial terms and send a counter-redline.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Eleanor Shaw <eleanor.shaw@aperturelabs.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: David Li <david.li@whitecaplegal.com>, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Labs MSA / Order Form - IP indemnity allocation

Ben / Kimberly / Markus —

Thanks — Aperture prefers Track B as a pragmatic compromise: customer wants reassurance that Redwood will lead the technical remediation where the model output is clearly the proximate cause, but Aperture will retain the right to step in. Procurement also accepts the 30-day default retention and will pay for any extended retention add-ons.

Next steps we can agree today:
- Aperture will share primary insurer contact and claims liaison by EOD Friday (we'll post the contact in HubSpot).
- Kimberly / Markus to circulate a one-page summary of agreed defense-control mechanics and the precise notice timeline; we will use that to close internal approvals.
- DocuSign path: we'll sign the counter-redline once the one-page operational summary is attached. Link: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-123-APERTURE

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Happy to do a 20-minute wrap-up call if anything else blocks.

Best,
Eleanor Shaw
Head of Procurement | Aperture Labs
attachments: proof_of-origin_snapshot.pdf (pdf)
